prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: shoulder injury. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1230; do not mention it.)
text:
I write this letter on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was operating a vehicle lawfully when the vehicle driven by your insured crossed the centre line and struck our client's vehicle head-on. Although the impact occurred at a low rate of speed, the force of the collision was sufficient to cause significant injury to our client's shoulder.

Following the collision, our client sought medical attention and was diagnosed with a soft tissue injury to the shoulder that has required ongoing treatment, including physical therapy and restrictions on work and daily activities. Our client's medical providers have documented the injury and its connection to the accident, and treatment is continuing.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured's failure to keep a proper lookout and to remain within their own lane directly caused this collision. We have reviewed the available evidence and see no basis on which your insured could be found free of fault.

On behalf of our client, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this accident. This demand will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will proceed with filing a lawsuit without further notice.
